notes: 1907 corner flat at Jackson: smooth lavender-pink stucco with a plain parapet and a thin cornice. A narrow squared bay at the south end over storeys 1-2, flat punched windows between, and a tall round (swell) corner bay at the north end. Ground: a brown panel door left, then a shopfront of lattice-paned windows toward the corner. Layout already matches (box bay left, round corner bay right, brown door, lattice shopfront); plainer coping (cornice projection 0.15, no brackets), dustier pink stucco, white window surrounds, lattice-grille shop window. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #cbbab6 -> #e5dcda (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
